name: finish
description: Call when the task is complete or unrecoverable. Halts the agent loop. Save any artifacts (recipe, audit) BEFORE calling finish.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary of the run.

name: view_env_state
description: Read one recorded state and its observation artifacts. Step -1 selects the latest entry. Embeds policy, agentview, and wrist images when available. Use the calibration-frame images for pixel back-projection; JSON state alone is not enough. Use agentview for global tabletop layout and object locations; use wrist for close-range details near the gripper, occlusions, and container/cabinet interiors.

name: pi0_pick
description: Pi0.5 closed-loop pick. Use it for the grasp; YOU then do every move_to and release. Use modest max_chunks and verify the grasp from EEF lift, gripper closure, and available images.

prompt.description: Pi0 prompt (e.g. 'pick up the akita black bowl').

lift_thresh.description: EEF post-descent ascent threshold for success, m (default 0.05)

gripper_open_thresh.description: Minimum finger separation accepted as a held object (default 0.0)

descent_thresh.description: Required descent before lift detection, m (default 0.10)

name: pi0_doubled
description: Pi0.5 closed-loop contact skill for non-pick interactions (e.g. stove/knob/button/short push). Returned success/task_success only mirrors official termination; for intermediate contact skills, success=false does not necessarily mean the contact interaction failed. Inspect image/state evidence. Do not use it as a general pick/place shortcut.

prompt.description: Contact-skill prompt, e.g. 'turn on the stove'.
